create_GigaChat3ToolParser: create a GigaChat3ToolParser instance with a tokenizer and optional tools list
extract_tool_calls: extract tool calls from a GigaChat3 model output string using extract_tool_calls method
extract_tool_calls_streaming: extract streaming tool calls from GigaChat3 model output using extract_tool_calls_streaming method
adjust_request: adjust a ChatCompletionRequest or ResponsesRequest to disable special token skipping for tool calls
parse_function_call_json: parse a GigaChat3 function call JSON block from model output using regex patterns
